policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.

DATA_DIR.holds: proteins.zip, ppassoc.zip and ddi.zip, the ogbn-proteins, ogbl-ppa and ogbl-ddi archives from snap.stanford.edu/ogb/data that ogb's dataset classes download

policy.forbidden: the OGB paper's result tables, the OGB leaderboards at ogb.stanford.edu, or other published OGB results

tasks.task_prompt: In examples/nodeproppred/proteins, run `python mlp.py` on ogbn-proteins; the `Final Test` line under `All runs:` prints the test mean ± std over its runs.

outputs.run.log: the example script's stdout and stderr
